title: fix(metadata-protocol): the customizations read lists a moved edit under the package that serves it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9W9WqZzLRELZak23ZMvZcMR)_

Fixes #31656

Clause-②: no — what the customizations list holds for a moved edit; no accept set changes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：套件拆分（或回滚）把条目挪到同一 App 的另一个包后，"包的定制列表"（`GET /packages/:id/customizations`）现在把租户的修改列在实际生效的新包下，且只列在那里。
- 为什么改：#31593 之后修改已在新包下生效，但列表仍按修改时声明的旧包来列：拆包后列在已不再发运该条目的 App 下、新模块下却没有；回滚后两边都列不出。列表改为读取与生效读取同一组候选与判定。
- 风险与回滚：只读，不写任何数据；"同一 App"仍只由安装记录（`appOf`）判定。条目锁本就读取该条目的全部存储行，实测对挪动的修改与在新包下保存的修改给出相同答案，未改，只加了钉。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-served-overrides.ts`（逐条目按候选顺序选行，以及"旧包不再列"的排除）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-overlay-follows-suite.test.ts`（需先构建 metadata-protocol），预期 12 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**As measured on `origin/main` after #31653.** The card read "listed under neither". Measured, it depends on the direction: after a flat → composed split the pair override declaring the App was still listed under the App (which no longer ships the item) and not under the module that serves it; after a composed → flat rollback it was listed under neither. Both are fixed.

**The list reads the served reads' own candidates, one reading (seat ruling 1).** `listServedOverrides` groups the pair's ACTIVE rows by item (folded type, name, bundle member) and picks each item's row through `servedOverlayRowCandidates` and `holdsServedOverlayCandidate`, in their order, with the item's shipping packages read the way the by-name read reads them (`shippingPackageIds(shippedArtifactsOf(...))`). So a package lists the pair's declared override of its item first, else the pair's override that `isMovedOverrideRowOf` holds as a moved edit. Same App is read only inside the predicates (`appOf` over installed manifests); no key list and no same-App test of its own.

**Listed only where it is served (ruling 2).** A declared override whose package no longer ships the item, which a package shipping it now holds as its moved edit (`isMovedOverrideRowOf`), is that package's and is not also listed under the former owner. A former owner that still ships the item keeps its edit, listed as today.

**The list stays the pair's rows.** A row bound to a package of the App itself (a Regime O save from before the ADR-0146 D11 close) is served at the new owner through `isMovedBaseRowOf`'s candidate, but it is not a pair row: it is listed under no package, before or after the move, as such a row bound to its still-shipping owner is not listed today. Named in the report's open questions. Since the list reads no base-bound rows, "two former owners' rows, list neither" has no listed case; the served reads already serve neither.

**Item lock (ruling 3): measured, unchanged.** The lock's overlay layer reads every ACTIVE row of the item whichever package it is bound to (`overlayLockLayerAt`, no package filter), so a moved edit was already in its scope. A pin holds that a moved edit carrying a stamped lock answers at the module exactly what the module's own edit answers: the read's `lock`/`editable`/`deletable`/`lockReason` and the save door's `ITEM_LOCKED`. No save door refusal changes.

Files: `protocol-served-overrides.ts`, `protocol.ts` (one host member, `shippedArtifactsOf`, passed to the list), the test, a patch changeset. `protocol.ts` is outside the delta's named surface: the host-split pattern needs the member wired there, as #31653 did for the by-name read. No `packages/spec/**`, no `ui/**`, no `docs/adr/**`; `served-override.ts` and `item-lock.ts` are not edited. No forced test edits.

## Tests

Six cases added to `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-overlay-follows-suite.test.ts` (the suite-move harness #31653 added: one SQLite tenant DB, a fresh real kernel per version), as a top-level `describe`:

1. flat → composed: the module lists the edit, the App does not.
2. composed → flat (rollback): the App lists the edit, the uninstalled module does not.
3. CONTROL: a former owner that still ships the view lists its edit as today; the module lists nothing.
4. NEGATIVE: another App's pair declaring HotCRM's App, and HotCRM's pair declaring the partner App: never listed under the module, the App or the partner.
5. CONTROL: a pre-close row bound to the App is served at the module and listed under neither, before or after the move.
6. The item lock answers for a moved edit at the module what it answers for the module's own edit (pinned, holds on main).

<details><summary>Red on main first (529e5351, fix sources restored from main, tests kept): 2 failed | 10 passed (12)</summary>

```
× flat → composed: the module lists the edit saved under the App, and the App no longer does
  AssertionError: expected { module: [], app: [ [ …(2) ] ] } to deeply equal { module: [ [ …(2) ] ], app: [] }
  (received app: [["x3677e_case.default", "6.1.0"]], module: [])
× composed → flat (rollback): the App lists the edit saved under the module, though the module is gone
  AssertionError: expected { app: [], module: [] } to deeply equal { app: [ [ …(2) ] ], module: [] }
Tests  2 failed | 10 passed (12)
```
The lock pin passes on main: the lock half of the premise does not hold.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, dist preflight, restore proven blob == HEAD each leg)</summary>

The runtime test reads `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through its `dist/`, so each leg rebuilt it; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in 2 built files before the run and in none of 24 after the restore build, with the tree clean. The legs ran on a local commit over #31653's branch head `0fad163d` (identical to its squash on main for every file it touched) whose `protocol-served-overrides.ts` blob `0b23b796` is the one at this PR's head.

- **A. Moved candidate not read by the list** (blob `0b23b796` → `2f6f269e`): `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)`, cases 1 and 2. Restored `0b23b796` == HEAD.
- **B. Former-owner exclusion removed** (→ `a53e1f98`): `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, case 1, the App lists the moved edit too. Restored == HEAD.
- **C. Moved candidate admitted without its predicate** (→ `7dfc0eba`): `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)`, cases 3 and 4, the module lists the App's still-shipped edit and the pair row declaring the partner App. Restored == HEAD.

Case 5 and the lock pin hold on main and guard behaviour this diff does not change, so no ablation is owed for them.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The package upgrade plan's override advice (`listOverrides` in `@objectstack/objectql`, #31627) reads this list, so it follows the same rule; its tests pass unchanged (`package-upgrade-environment.test.ts`).
- Lock prose ranking: among several rows declaring the strictest lock, the row bound to the address's own package ranks first. A moved base row is bound to the former owner, so it ranks as another package's row; the lock value is unaffected, and a pair row ranks the same moved or not. Not changed here.

## Verification

Heavy runs through `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- **Typecheck:** metadata-protocol 0, runtime 0 (runtime's `check:test-typecheck` first reported `organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts`, a known prerequisite: the optional peer `driver-turso` had no dist; built, re-run 0).
- **Lint:** eslint `--no-inline-config` over the 2 changed sources and the test, exit 0.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 72 families; all 72 run on `a135e658`, each exit 0 (also on `28e7e921`, where two first exited 3 on container prerequisites: the teardown self-test's fixture commit, fetched; `dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every dist, after `pnpm build` 0). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 0 lost.
- **Dogfood:** not owed (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
